description: PvE binding-vow lottery rows that define the candidate vow IDs available from a mission-selected lottery.

Id.simple: Lottery row key selected from the PvE mission's Id_BindingVowsLottery/Weights lists.
Id.technical: FName key in BindingVowsLotteryDataTable; export label ID. IntervalPvE_PickBindingVows builds (lottery Id, weight) pairs from the PvEMission row, picks a weighted index, then resolves that key with IntervalPvE_FindRowInline over BindingVowsLotteryDataTables. There is no bank-specific weighting inside this table; every non-None candidate receives weight 1.0. None keys are skipped by the mission side.

Id_BindingVows.simple: Candidate BindingVowsDataTable IDs in this lottery.
Id_BindingVows.technical: TArray<FName>. Each non-None ID becomes a candidate with weight 1.0; duplicates are ignored (ContainsByPredicate on the key). Candidates are then filtered by MissionOrder/MissionTask ExcludeBindingVowsEffectType, using each vow's resolved BindingVowsEffect rows, and a weighted distinct pick selects Count IDs for the mission. All exported rows have 12 slots, but the consumer does not assume a fixed length and skips None.

notes: AGameDataTableManager::Tick resolves only the single retail asset BindingVowsLotteryDataTable into BindingVowsLotteryDataTables (Source/Abrams/Private/GameDataTableManager.cpp:292, Source/Abrams/Public/GameDataTableManager.h:203).

The only identifiable row-struct consumer in the reconstructed source is IntervalPvE_PickBindingVows; no other C++ reader of this exact struct was found. Blueprint/uncooked consumers cannot be excluded from the partial Content set.
Evidence is reconstructed retail-behaviour source plus serialized export schema; exported array values are not treated as semantic proof.

usages.detail: IntervalPvE_PickBindingVows assembles mission lottery keys and weights.
Resolves the weighted-selected lottery row from BindingVowsLotteryDataTables.
Turns Id_BindingVows into unique unit-weight candidates, filters by effect type exclusions, then picks distinct vows.
